findings.message: The verification artifact marks AC-001 through AC-004 and REQ-004/REQ-005 verified, but the required visual evidence does not establish those outcomes: WIT-001 shows cos(x) * x, WIT-002/WIT-003 show calculator mode rather than a graph, and WIT-004 shows calculator layouts without the graph. The pinned planning and implementation inputs explicitly say visual acceptance remains to be inspected and cannot be inferred from unit checks. Correct the verification claims/evidence or obtain appropriate visual witnesses; the current evidence does not support a release recommendation.

The artifact says 34 tests passed in a run recorded as `.-node-tests`, while the specification and plan require a Playwright verification of the circle geometry and separate desktop/tablet visual inspection. The implementation summary says no governed test execution is retained and visual acceptance remains pending. Therefore the recorded run does not establish the specified Playwright circle assertion or responsive visual acceptance; the verified status and release recommendation overstate the pinned evidence.
